reason: A static bilingual web portal for discovering, filtering, sorting, and copying installation commands for a curated DSH plugin catalog, with lightweight ecosystem data visualizations.

summaries.zh: 用于浏览、搜索、筛选和安装 DSH 插件目录的双语静态门户。
summaries.en: A bilingual static portal for browsing, searching, filtering, and copying installation commands for DSH plugins.

capabilities: Displays and searches a curated catalog of DSH plugins
Filters and sorts locally stored plugin metadata
Copies plugin installation commands to the clipboard
Can fetch upstream repository data when regenerating the static data snapshot
